entry.title: Audiences
entry.summary: The reader personas this documentation serves — who they are, what they want, and what they are accountable for.
entry.content:
The personas below describe who this documentation is written for. Each persona page carries the reader’s role, goals, and responsibilities, so an audience reference elsewhere in the tree resolves to a page that says something concrete about the reader it points at.

Draft personas are omitted from the list below (and from the sitemap, RSS feed, and agent index) until they are promoted to active.
